end.summary:
Covered speed as distance/time using numerical examples.
Discussed constant speed and its straight-line graph.
Practised acceleration, including negative acceleration during braking.
Calculated average speed for a round trip.
Distinguished speed from velocity and noted that changing direction changes velocity.
end.parentNote: At home, ask them to describe one journey where speed stays the same but direction changes, and explain what happens to velocity.
